name: @neuctra/finance-mcp

tools.name: get_setup_guide
tools.description: Start here. How Neuctra Finance fits together, installing @neuctra/finance, creating the client, keys and permissions, and testing safely. Call once before writing any Finance code.

tools.name: list_sdk_methods
tools.description: Every @neuctra/finance method with the permission it needs and what it does. Only these exist.

tools.name: get_sdk_method
tools.description: Full detail for one method: permission, params, return value, errors it can raise and an example. Example names: expenses.record, income.record, transfers.create, holds.capture.

method.description: Method name. One of: me, summary, accounts.list, accounts.get, accounts.canSpend, expenses.record, income.record, transfers.create, transactions.reverse, transactions.list, transactions.get, transactions.iterate, debts.list, debts.get, debts.create, debts.pay, holds.authorize, holds.get, holds.capture, holds.void, spendRequests.create, spendRequests.get, spendRequests.cancel, verifyWebhook

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: A complete, correct example for a task, including handling the failure cases. Examples: record-expense, record-income, transfer-money, read-transactions, manage-debts, reserve-money, request-approval, fix-a-mistake, handle-webhooks, safe-retries, rest-api.

example.description: One of: record-expense, record-income, transfer-money, read-transactions, manage-debts, reserve-money, request-approval, fix-a-mistake, handle-webhooks, safe-retries, rest-api

tools.name: get_error_reference
tools.description: What an error code means and what to do about it. Omit `code` for the full list.

instructions: Neuctra Finance records where business money goes (expenses, income, transfers, debts, holds, approvals) through the @neuctra/finance SDK. Do not write Finance code from memory. Call get_setup_guide once, then list_sdk_methods, then get_sdk_method for each call you will write. Use get_example for a complete workflow (record an expense, record income...) and get_error_reference when a call fails. If a method is not listed, it does not exist.
